rule: Statuses are server-side millisecond timers. Each status has a synced boolean plus an unsynced cooldown; poison has a synced stack number. Burn and poison tick once per second as a percent of max HP (poison scaled by stacks, cap 3 by default). Control statuses (sleep, freeze, paralysis, charm, confusion) do not stack with themselves; re-application is refused or only extends a longer timer. Ending a sleep or freeze opens a fixed 1500 ms window in which no new sleep or freeze can land (anti-chain-stun). Weather, ability, item and zone-like modifiers multiply durations or tick damage. Charm forces movement toward the charmer. Flinch halves shield absorption. Every tenth block by a unit knocks an adjacent attacker to a safe cell and deals the blocker's attack back as physical damage. Client shows one badge per true boolean and dispatches on each synced field change.

data_fields.name: poison_stack_cap
data_fields.unit: stacks (equal to max attackers, 3 for Frankendom)

data_fields.name: charm_hit_wear
data_fields.unit: ms removed per hit from charmer

data_fields.name: flinch_shield_share
data_fields.unit: fraction of hit absorbed by shield

data_fields.name: weather_duration_multiplier
data_fields.unit: multiplier per status per zone tag

data_fields.name: status_end_time
data_fields.unit: server ms timestamp (to send to client)

keep: One badge per status over the head, with a heavier badge at poison stack 3
Charm as a forced walk toward the controller (a readable behaviour, not a number)
Control statuses do not stack with themselves
1500 ms control immunity window after sleep or freeze ends
Cure-on-apply items (berry eaten, status cleared at once)
Immunity as data per item and per passive
Knockback on every tenth block as a stagger beat
change: Sync the status end time so the client can show time left (Keldaan syncs booleans only)
Do not send a number every tick per unit: batch to one floating number per second per target
Set the stack cap to the attacker count (3) so DoT never exceeds the attackers in a many-vs-one fight
Badge placement: test above-head against a fixed unit-card badge at 375 wide before choosing
Keldaan lets 35 booleans reach the client; Frankendom should send one status event with id, stacks and end time
look_test: Preview scene at 375 wide: one target against three attackers. Variant A: poison stacks as an above-head badge that swaps to a heavier badge at 3 stacks, one number per second. Variant B: the same stacks on a fixed unit-card badge with a time-left ring and no number. Then freeze as a centred badge (A) vs above-head (B), with the 1.5 s immunity window shown as a grey pulse when the freeze ends. Dom judges which he can read mid-fight in one second and whether the grey pulse makes chain-stun obvious. 5 minutes.
